entries.name: Cyborg
entries.sourceReference: Teen Titans (2003), Cyborg: clean silver/white-blue cybernetic body and integrated arm cannon. DC series page confirms the continuity and roster; Final Exam transcript explicitly describes his sonic cannon. Exact movement, timing and poses here are authored adaptations, not official episode frames.
entries.identityCorrection: Teen Titans 2003 design: clean white/silver plates with blue circles, black joints, brown human face and integrated cybernetics. Base simple attack is a cybernetic fist, not an invented handheld gun.

entries.name: Beast Boy
entries.sourceReference: Teen Titans (2003), Beast Boy shapeshifter. A complete green gorilla is the explicit combat-form selection for the resolved gorilla fist/charge/guard kit. This separate animal body uses no humanoid costume or partial mutation. Episode transcripts/indexed character descriptions support true green animal transformations, but this16-pose cycle is an authored adaptation.
entries.identityCorrection: Complete green gorilla combat body selected explicitly for Poing du gorille vert/Charge du gorille vert/Garde du gorille vert. This is true ape anatomy in all sixteen cells, with no human face, clothes, boots or enlarged humanoid substitute. The retained form is an authored selection of the 2003 shapeshifter's native animal body, not official source frames.

sourceDensityCalibration.note: Independent gorilla anatomy source; calibrate its own full animal idle reference to220px and preserve natural quadrupedal stance ratios. No comparison to a human or T-Rex ROI.

statureReview.reason: A complete quadrupedal green gorilla body is the explicit combat form, with its own261px native head-to-foot idle ROI. All source stance-height ratios stay within this animal anatomy; no human body is enlarged or used as the animal reference. Authored220px body calibration is not canonical size.
